name: Leonardo AI
tagline: Enterprise-grade AI image generation for print-ready assets
description: Leonardo AI is a powerful generative AI platform that creates high-resolution, print-quality images, game assets, and design elements. Its customizable model training and batch generation make it ideal for print-on-demand product mockups and packaging design at scale.

name: Runway Gen-3 Alpha
tagline: Next-gen AI video creation for print marketing campaigns
description: Runway Gen-3 Alpha enables print shops and e-commerce brands to create professional video ads, product demos, and social media content using text prompts. Its frame-consistent generation and green screen tools help print businesses showcase products dynamically.

name: ElevenLabs
tagline: Ultra-realistic AI voice generation for print shop video ads
description: ElevenLabs produces the most lifelike AI voiceovers for video ads, product tutorials, and audio content. Print shops can voice their promotional videos with studio-quality narration, multi-language support, and voice cloning for brand consistency.

name: HeyGen
tagline: AI avatar videos for print shop marketing at scale
description: HeyGen allows print businesses to create professional spokesperson videos with AI avatars in minutes. Perfect for product launch announcements, printing tutorials, and social media marketing without the cost of hiring actors or video production teams.

name: Jasper AI
tagline: AI copywriting platform for print product descriptions and ads
description: Jasper AI helps print-on-demand sellers and print shops generate persuasive product descriptions, ad copy, email campaigns, and landing page content. With brand voice customization and SEO optimization, it streamlines content marketing for print businesses.

name: Copy.ai
tagline: Automated copywriting for e-commerce and print marketing
description: Copy.ai is an AI-powered copywriting tool that generates high-converting product descriptions, blog posts, social media captions, and email sequences. Print shop owners can create compelling marketing copy in seconds, optimized for conversion and SEO.

name: Typeface
tagline: Enterprise AI content platform for branded print marketing
description: Typeface is an enterprise-grade generative AI platform purpose-built for brand content creation. It enables print shops and marketing teams to produce on-brand product catalogs, social media assets, and advertising creatives with consistent brand identity.

name: Frase.io
tagline: AI-powered SEO content optimization for print shop websites
description: Frase.io helps print businesses research, write, and optimize SEO content that ranks. It analyzes search intent, builds content briefs, and generates AI-written articles optimized for local and e-commerce search — critical for print shops competing online.

name: Writesonic
tagline: All-in-one AI writing for print shop SEO and ads
description: Writesonic is a comprehensive AI writing platform offering blog posts, product descriptions, ad copy, landing pages, and more. Print businesses can use its e-commerce templates and SEO tools to generate content that drives traffic and sales.

name: Canva Print
tagline: Design-to-print platform with AI-powered layout tools
description: Canva Print extends Canva's AI design capabilities into full print production — design business cards, flyers, posters, and packaging with AI assistance, then order professional printing directly. Its Magic Studio tools (Magic Eraser, Magic Expand, Magic Write) streamline the design-to-print workflow for small businesses.
